items.description: Close and repaint the disturbed wall
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover closing the necessary access opening and repainting the affected patch. The estimate allows €170 for patching and €110 for local preparation and painting.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge on this contractor's invoice. The gross estimate uses the €81 reference for one charge.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.8(d) allow minor consumables used in the pipe repair. The estimate allows €10 for one small quantity of sealing material.
Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) cover the necessary replacement section of the failed indoor supply pipe. One metre is estimated at €27 gross at equivalent pre-loss specification under §7.1.9.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstating insulation on the repaired pipe where it was present before the loss. The estimate allows €18 for one metre, consistent with Case 18.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers customary labour reasonably required for the repair. One installer hour at the supplied €63 rate gives €63 gross.

Section 7.1.8(b) excludes a separately charged contractor-owned measuring device, even when the investigation itself is necessary. The €18 conditional estimate would apply if this were documented as necessary third-party hire rather than the contractor's own device.

items.description: First service technician labour entry, 9 hours
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(g) covers reasonable technician time for opening the wall, accessing the pipe and carrying out the repair. The supplied gross benchmark for the full nine-hour line is €425.

Section 7.1.7(f) allows only the first travel charge per contractor per invoice, even when there were multiple visits. The €81 figure is the conditional benchmark for a single eligible trip, not an additional allowance.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover one equipment deployment charge for necessary drying. A short deployment for the localized wall damage is estimated at €65 gross.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes a contractor's own blades as business equipment. The €9 figure is a conditional gross value for one blade, not an allowance under this wording.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers fittings needed to reconnect the repaired pipe at the pre-loss standard. Two ordinary fittings at €22 each give €44 gross.

items.description: Second stainless steel pipe entry, 1 m
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.8(c) and (d) exclude duplicate or unsupported quantities; this repeats the one-metre pipe entry at position 4 without a separately documented length. If an additional metre is substantiated, the conditional estimate is €27 gross.

Sections 7.1.8(c) and (d) exclude duplicate or unsupported insulation costs; position 5 already bills one metre for the localized repair. If this shell is shown to cover a distinct necessary metre, the conditional estimate is €18 gross.

items.description: Second service technician labour entry, 9 hours
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.8(c) and 7.1.7(g) bar duplicate or unsupported labour; multiple visits do not by themselves substantiate a second identical nine-hour entry. If separate necessary hours are documented, the supplied gross benchmark for the full line is €425.
